issues.description: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat constructor still validates numMergeWorkers/mergeExec but discards them, causing UnsupportedOperationException only at write time
issues.detail: The constructor keeps argument validation (numMergeWorkers>1 requires mergeExec, etc.) but no longer stores numMergeWorkers/mergeExec fields. Combined with fieldsWriter throwing UnsupportedOperationException, the constructor's executor-validation logic is now dead code that misleads callers into thinking writes are supported. Either remove validation or document/restrict the constructor to read-only use clearly.

issues.description: Public NAME constant downgraded to package-private breaks external callers and SPI assumptions
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME were `public static final` and are now package-private. Downstream code (e.g. Elasticsearch, custom codecs referencing these constants for SPI registration or compatibility checks) will fail to compile. Backwards codecs typically remain accessible by name; this is a breaking API change beyond a simple move.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than referenced from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat
issues.detail: A new `static final int DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT = 16` constant is added to Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat, replacing the prior `Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat.DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT` import in the writer. If the core constant ever changes, the legacy reader/writer silently diverges. Since the package is now separate, this duplication should at minimum be commented as intentionally pinned to the v99 on-disk layout.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues protected fields demoted to package-private break subclass extension
issues.detail: The class remains `public abstract` with a public DenseOffHeapVectorValues subclass, but the previously `protected` fields (dimension, size, slice, etc.) are now package-private. External subclasses outside the package can no longer access these fields, breaking the abstract contract. Either keep them protected or seal the class.

issues.description: CHANGES.txt attributes Lucene104 format addition to GITHUB#15223 but diff does not add it
issues.detail: The CHANGES entry claims `Lucene104HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat replaces the now legacy Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat`, but this PR only moves the legacy format; no Lucene104 format appears in the diff. Either the changelog overstates this PR's scope or the new format is missing. Verify the replacement format actually exists/is wired before merging this changelog wording.

issues.description: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat constructor visibility inconsistent (protected no-arg, package-private with args)
issues.detail: The sole no-arg constructor is `protected`, while the (Float, int, boolean) constructor is package-private. Since the class itself is package-public with no abstract members, the mixed visibility is confusing. Choose one consistently (likely package-private for both) given this is a test-only RW shim.

review.summary: This PR cleanly moves the Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats to backward_codecs and stubs the writer to throw UnsupportedOperationException, with test-only RW shims preserving coverage. Main concerns: the constructor still validates merge-executor arguments it no longer stores (dead/misleading code), and the previously-public NAME constants and protected OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields were silently demoted, which is an API break for downstream consumers. The CHANGES.txt entry references a Lucene104 replacement format that does not appear in this diff and should be verified. A duplicated DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant should at least be commented as version-pinned.
